expected_run_fields.dataset_sha256: 64 hex digits, dataset version must match across arms
expected_run_fields.hardware_id: same exact machine + CPU/GPU SKU and driver for each arm
expected_run_fields.eval_protocol: same eval tasks, decoding settings, validation code version
expected_run_fields.inference_flops_per_utf8_byte: measured/estimated inference FLOPs divided by original UTF-8 output bytes; record derivation
expected_run_fields.joule_per_utf8_byte: measured energy in J divided by original UTF-8 output bytes
expected_run_fields.latency_ms_per_utf8_byte: measured latency / original UTF-8 output bytes
expected_run_fields.training_compute_flops: training FLOPs summed for all phases; compare within 5%
expected_run_fields.model_params: number of trainable model parameters; compare within 5%
